reasons: Locked target is the fallback, and every atomic fallback element is present in operative text: mutuality, scope limited to personnel directly involved in performing or receiving the Services, twelve months measured from the end of involvement, general-advertisement carve-out, unsolicited-approach carve-out, and solicitation-only (no no-hire).

The official literal checks for '12 months from the end of involvement' and the unsolicited-approach carve-out appear to be pattern artefacts (the clause spells 'twelve' and uses 'approaches that party on an unsolicited basis'); the operative language satisfies both requirements read literally.
Preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) is not achieved because Customer remains restricted, but that is consistent with the drafter's locked fallback target.

The official word/character-ratio minimality gate fails, but the original clause was defective on every fallback element (one-way, eighteen months, all Vendor personnel, no-hire, no carve-outs), so no operator, number, or short-phrase edit would suffice; a single replacement of the sentence is the tightest available route.
Minor, non-fatal softening: 'knowingly' qualifies the solicitation duty. It is symmetrical and does not weaken our position, so it is noted rather than flagged.
No undefined terms, contradictions, or dangling mechanics are introduced; surrounding sections remain untouched and effective.
